WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_diff
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_abs_diff) AS overall_avg_abs_diff
  FROM step1
  WHERE avg_abs_diff IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  step1.corpeventprx,
  step1.avg_anlycount,
  step1.avg_abs_diff,
  CASE WHEN step2.overall_avg_abs_diff IS NOT NULL 
       THEN step1.avg_abs_diff - step2.overall_avg_abs_diff 
       END AS difference
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.overall_avg_abs_diff IS NOT NULL
